method: DoubleMLAPOS per https://docs.doubleml.org/stable/examples/learners/py_tabpfn.html. Outcome is log(Lump Sum); ATE is reported in log-dollars, so 0.10 is roughly a 10% change in the award.
imputation: median fill plus a per-column missingness indicator, because DoubleML needs complete rows and complete-case would leave 149

adjustment_sets.naive: every other column -- conditions on mediators and on a collider
adjustment_sets.dag: the treatment's parents in the assembled graph, i.e. the backdoor set

caveat: DoubleML estimates effect SIZE given an assumed direction and adjustment set. It cannot orient an edge: swap treatment and outcome and it will estimate that too, without complaint.

dag.skipped: the assembled graph gives this variable no parents
